answer: A canyon assay vault locks 160 POA per agent for 90 days on one key and issues a copper-stamped receipt after a fresh task from a random peer. Three random staked peers must countersign it within 2 hours. Weekly auditors re-run one receipt per vault: a fake burns 40 POA and freezes it 21 days; a second failure slashes all 160 POA and bans the key 80 days. Forging 1,000 agents costs 160,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 3,000 countersignatures weekly. Like a canyon toll bridge stamping a copper coin with each traveler's name, a forger must mint 1,000 coins and cross 1,000 times an hour.
